annotation.title_clean: ロボット介護機器開発・導入促進事業(開発補助事業) 研究基本計画
annotation.title_en: Robotic Care Equipment Development and Introduction Promotion Project (Development Subsidy Project): Basic Research Plan
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 経済産業省製造産業局産業機械課 (METI, Industrial Machinery Division)
annotation.venue: Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI)
annotation.summary_en: METI's October 2017 basic plan for the subsidy programme developing and introducing nursing-care robots in Japan. It defines priority areas (transfer assistance, mobility, toileting, monitoring, bathing, communication, care work support), stage-gate reviews via AMED, minimum safety verification, ethics review for trials, and incident reporting.
key_provisions_or_claims: Subsidises development of care robots in 6 priority fields and 13 items defined in annexes
Stage-gate reviews by AMED with development targets including safety verification
Minimum safety verification: electrical safety, EMC, static strength and stability tests
Human-subject trials require prior consultation, ethics review and incident reporting
Standard-setting/evaluation contractor develops guidelines and standardisation; results shared via portal and partnership
